description:
Title: Ordering in an Online Shop  

A customer that logs into an E-Shop system and has to wait for its login confirmation (its credentials are checked by the system).
If the login was successful then the customer can continue to select products, else the shopping experience stops.
After selecting a product the customer has to add it to a shopping cart, save the product and check if every product was already selected.
These steps repeat until all products were selected.
Then the order is finished by the shopping system and simultaneously payment and shipment for the order is prepared.
For the payment the customer has to enter its payment data and has to wait until the bank confirms the payment.
While waiting for the payment confirmation the customer can enter its shipping address (an independent billing address can be entered if the shipping address is not equal to the billing address).
Finally if the address and the payment steps are executed then the order will be finished by the system.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_OnlineShop"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/online-shop">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BankConfirmation" name="Bank payment confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OnlineShop">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OnlineShop" name="Customer and E-Shop system" processRef="Process_OnlineShop"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BankConfirmation" name="Bank payment confirmation" sourceRef="Participant_Bank" targetRef="Task_WaitBankConfirmation" messageRef="Message_BankConfirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OnlineShop" name="Ordering in an Online Shop" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_OnlineShop">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Login</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WaitLoginConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_LoginSuccessful</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ShoppingStops</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectProduct</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AddToCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SaveProduct</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckAllProductsSelected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AllProductsSelected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterPaymentData</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WaitBankConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterShippingAddress</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AddressesEqual</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterBillingAddress</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AddressMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PaymentAndAddressJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_OrderComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_EShopSystem" name="E-Shop system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckCredentials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideLoginConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PreparationSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FinishOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PreparePayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareShipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PreparationJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FinishOrderAfterDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Login" name="Log in to the E-Shop"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCredentials" name="Check customer credentials"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideLoginConfirmation" name="Provide login confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WaitLoginConfirmation" name="Wait for login confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LoginSuccessful" name="Login successful?" default="Flow_LoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ShoppingStops" name="Shopping experience stops"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectProduct" name="Select a product"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddToCart" name="Add product to shopping cart"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAllProductsSelected" name="Check whether every product was selected"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" name="Every product selected?" default="Flow_MoreProducts"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Start order finishing and preparations"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinishOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Order finishing and preparations complete"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterPaymentData" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_WaitBankConfirmation" name="Wait for bank payment confirmation" messageRef="Message_BankConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PaymentAndAddressSplit" name="Wait for payment confirmation and enter address"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterShippingAddress" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AddressesEqual" name="Shipping address equals billing address?" default="Flow_DifferentAddresses"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterBillingAddress" name="Enter independent billing address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AddressMerge" name="Merge address alternatives"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PaymentAndAddressJoin" name="Payment and address steps complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinishOrderAfterDetails" name="Finish order after payment and address steps"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderComplete" name="Order complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_Login" targetRef="Task_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_CheckCredentials" targetRef="Task_ProvideLoginConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_ProvideLoginConfirmation" targetRef="Task_WaitLoginConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_WaitLoginConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_LoginSuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginSuccess" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginSuccessful" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">loginSuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginFailure" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginSuccessful" targetRef="End_ShoppingStops"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_AddToCart" targetRef="Task_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_SaveProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckAllProductsSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_CheckAllProductsSelected" targetRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllSelected" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">allProductsSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MoreProducts" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Preparation_FinishOrder" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_FinishOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Preparation_Payment" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Preparation_Shipment" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinishOrder_Join" sourceRef="Task_FinishOrder" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparePayment_Join" sourceRef="Task_PreparePayment" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareShipment_Join" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShipment" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_EnterPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_EnterPaymentData" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentAndAddressSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitForPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentAndAddressSplit" targetRef="Task_WaitBankConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterAddress" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentAndAddressSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentComplete" sourceRef="Task_WaitBankConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentAndAddressJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_AddressesEqual"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddressesSame" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AddressesEqual" targetRef="Gateway_AddressMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">shippingAddressEqualsBillingAddress</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DifferentAddresses" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AddressesEqual" targetRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingAddressEntered" sourceRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_AddressMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddressComplete" sourceRef="Gateway_AddressMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentAndAddressJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentAndAddressJoin" targetRef="Task_FinishOrderAfterDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_FinishOrderAfterDetails" targetRef="End_OrderComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
